question.worked_solution:
Here, we apply the addition, constant multiple, and power rules:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2{x}^{7}+\frac{1}{{x}^{2}}+2x-2) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2{x}^{7})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{-2})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2x)-\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2) \\  & =2\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{7})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{-2})+2\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(x)-\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2) \\  & =2\cdot 7{x}^{(7-1)}+(-2){x}^{(-2-1)}+2\cdot 1-0 \\  & =14{x}^{6}-2{x}^{-3}+2 \\  & =14{x}^{6}-\frac{2}{{x}^{3}}+2\end{aligned}
$$
